item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IBIO-01 Bioingegneria

The research activity will focus on identifying the functional and densitometric changes induced by targeted physical exercise programmes aiming to integrate those into BoneStrength, an already existing in silico trial framework able to extract the hip fracture rate from virtual cohorts of femurs. The project concerns the incremental development of FlowAI, a software tool for hemodynamic simulation of the aorta that combines artificial intelligence and computational fluid dynamics (CFD). The hemodynamic CFD environment will be extended to different aortic vascular segments and complemented by a new module for simulating stent deployment within the aortic lumen, supporting the planning of endovascular procedures.
